method: Read all 271 global governance, guarantee and lifecycle propositions, all 42 complete context profiles and 9 exact caption occurrence sets. The complete preamble, source/governance discipline, implementation-instruction boundary, deterministic/epistemic guarantees and ordered lifecycle were read as controlling source content, not executed. Every full original payload and all 1,931 ordered bindings are verified against immutable evidence and exact source bytes. The literal no-earlier-than timing guard is distinguished from actual amended due evaluation. Archived inputs are verified in memory against durable regular-member custody; no code, tests or proof results were consulted.

decisions.PRESERVED_METADATA_AND_OBJECTIVE: The exact repository, normative/manifest paths, deployment origin/base, subject-neutral model and correctness-without-unsupported-confidence objective remain. A–F2 refines declared mechanisms without changing these identities or granting this source reviewer implementation execution authority.
decisions.PRESERVED_IMPLEMENTATION_DISCIPLINE: The existing-app, actual-starting-commit, smallest-complete-correction and ordered repair/permanent-regression/deployment/live-byte duties remain, with every prohibition on substitutes, premature success, isolated fixes, unrelated visual/refactoring/parallel architecture and manual resupply/identity/hash/schema/gate work. Actual current conformance/affected-path/operator scenarios are separately changed. These source instructions were reviewed as content, not executed.
decisions.PRESERVED_INSTRUCTION_BOUNDARY: Implementation instructions, audits, repair commentary and repository governance remain outside ordinary runtime state/prompts/packages/screens/artifacts, preserving the explicit separate-substantive-requirement exception. Runtime carriers contain only required operation identities/profile. A–F2 data semantics do not permit embedding or delegating repository instructions.
decisions.PRESERVED_PRECEDENCE_AND_HONESTY: The global sufficient-refutation REJECTED before required-unknown BLOCKED before all-mandatory-satisfied ACCEPTED order remains, with all blockers retained. B truth values and D result distinctions do not reorder it. File authority, human-origin confirmation, authorization-versus-delivery and instruction boundary remain. F2 support supplies neither success nor independence.
decisions.PRESERVED_MANIFEST_STRUCTURE: Exact source/commit identity, repository-only schema/path/fields, no self-hash, single manifest and per-entry trace-field structure remain. Independent extraction before draft disclosure, distinct reconciliation, digest-bound challenge records and material/uncovered/missing-challenge blocking remain. Actual amended coverage populations are separately changed; no source report becomes application evidence.
decisions.PRESERVED_DETERMINISTIC_GUARANTEES: Each exact sole producer, exhaustive/disjoint ownership, external-write prohibition and application-controlled identity/lifecycle/scope/count/gate/convergence/release/artifact authority remains. Actual-byte hash/size, atomic commit-or-no-change, exact raw provenance, registered derivation attribution and released-byte identity remain. This preserves ownership and trace mechanisms, not actual current semantic completeness.
decisions.PRESERVED_FAIL_CLOSED: Every named malformed/stale/incomplete/unsupported/contradictory/uncertain output remains fail-closed and the original five labels remain permitted. A/C/D/F1/F2 new validity/data/platform/input cases use that boundary without endorsing an old validator or specific favorable result.
decisions.PRESERVED_EPISTEMIC_LIMITS: Every prohibition on automatic semantic/source truth, loss-proof browser storage, absence of unknown defects, universal specialized/native capability, unmeasured perfect reliability and semantic completeness from raw counts remains. C accounting and F2 echoes do not establish semantic extraction/observed independence. The conditional measured-reliability language and stated approximate3/N reporting rule remain; no measurement is made here.
decisions.PRESERVED_ADDITIONAL_BOUNDARIES: Exact prompt/file byte identity, raw-before-parse response capture, application-owned slots independent of filename/order, optional clipboard, registered canonical ID allocation, atomic self-valid terminal calculation and separate authorization/attempt/completion states remain. C1 preserves response transport; F1/F2 grant no transfer authority. Actual closed-registry and due-evaluation contents are separately changed.
decisions.PRESERVED_CONTROLLER_AND_LIFECYCLE: The single static phone-first provider/subject-neutral controller and every coordinated actor/state/artifact/history remain. Both exact commit paths and the final-delivery sequence retain their full order. Human acceptance applies only where its contract requires; application calculations do not become human semantic proposals. A/E use existing lifecycle and F1/F2 preserve owning writers.
decisions.PRESERVED_WORKFLOW_INVENTORY: Every individually named lifecycle capability remains, including all ten independent executions, independent verification, correction/confirmation, final-product/representation/release/evidence/permanent history. Added conditional operations remain within existing stages. Inventory preservation certifies no implementation, actual current completion or proof.
decisions.EXACT_GLOBAL_GOVERNOR: Each original caption retains its exact individual governed range/ID set and actor/modality, including complete global precedence order and exact guarantee/prohibition domains. Blank-only endpoint qualifications remain as frozen. New clauses and adjacent standalone context are never absorbed into the original occurrence set; changed child duties are separately reconciled.
decisions.CURRENT_NATIVE_REPRESENTABILITY_AND_ROUT: D closes the supported primitive/selector/parser/numeric semantics used to determine faithful native representability; unsupported/unfaithful propositions retain exact external routing. F2 supplies route-specific input basis without changing executor or authorizing fallback. Applicable attributed XML-governor linkage remains separately required, not inferred from code.
decisions.CURRENT_IMPLEMENTATION_CONFORMANCE_AND_O: The actual current conforming/conflicting mechanism universe, affected downstream scope and declared deployed/live/operator scenarios include applicable A–F2 request, proof, accounting, native, variance and conditional execution/input behavior. Preserve smallest-complete repair and proof honesty. This source obligation is content, not permission for source-only implementation access; old success cannot establish a changed trigger.
decisions.CURRENT_DUE_CONDITIONS: Actual evaluation of current due obligations uses B accepted reviewed availability and F1 exact conditional routes with current compatible binding/history/reached phase and TRUE prerequisites, plus applicable F2 execution/input constraints. Original target-existence, earliest-stage and required-by timing guards remain. This group concerns actual due evaluation; the literal no-earlier-than guard is separately corrected as retained.
decisions.CURRENT_PROFILE_MIGRATION: Actual complete deterministic current-profile migration must satisfy amended records/fields, accounting, test/proof/variance and conditional route/input constraints with exact provenance, or remain historical/nongating. Schema equality or complete-looking receipts cannot invent authority/review/execution/evidence/history. No old proof is inherited.
decisions.CURRENT_NORMATIVE_COVERAGE_AND_TRACE: Current manifest generation/review, distinct obligation coverage, complete sections and required implementation/proof trace populations include all applicable A–F2 duties and changed contexts. Unchanged line bytes or old IDs cannot substitute for changed meaning. Keep every original ID/occurrence and new duty separately accounted, with stable identity and distinct reconciliation. This is source-impact evidence, not proof of implementation relationships.
decisions.CURRENT_OMISSION_CHALLENGE_ACCOUNTING: The source-prescribed project-content omission-challenge discipline now includes C/C1 exact physical and authorized structural accounting, additive retained parent/child occurrences and explicit blocked/unknown bounds when applicable. Exact semantic reading and independent extraction before draft disclosure remain. Coarse whole-file counting or matching bytes cannot establish complete source coverage.
decisions.CURRENT_RESPONSE_CONTRACT_AND_CONTEXT: Actual accepted response operation, exact response contract/context/scope and complete validation/acceptance consume A closed requests/answers, B references, C/C1 input accounting, D admitted definitions/results, E normalization and F1/F2 current route/input constraints. Original job/stage/revision/prompt-byte binding remains. No matching high-level label or old accepted payload proves current semantics.
decisions.CURRENT_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE_RESOLUTION: Current relationship-type resolution includes B nested proofExpressions and E exact one-current-test binding through existing tempKey/current supplied recordId ingestion, with explicit authored placement and application resolution. No agent-authored canonical identity or cross-project reference is allowed; sole resolver authority remains.
decisions.CURRENT_CLOSED_REGISTRY_COMPLETENESS: Actual current field, stage-operation, scope, derivation and normalizer closure includes applicable A–F2 contracts and conditional routes/input basis. High-level labels cannot supply missing semantic definitions. Original owner/identity/allocation rules remain; historical qualifier edges await explicit attributed dependency linkage.
decisions.CORRECTION_98: The base88 atom is the literal prohibition on becoming due before target existence and EARLIEST_EXECUTABLE_STAGE, not the complete actual due predicate. B successor2050 expressly leaves due predicate and phase timing unchanged; F1 successor1195/1201 preserves reached earliest stage, future visibility and original timing. Retain this exact no-earlier-than guard and its original occurrence set. Actual due evaluation at base181/index196 remains changed for current B/F1/F2 dependencies.

qualifier: The separately accepted technical-reference interpretation resolves policy meaning in its exact attributed scope. These historical reference qualifiers are preserved pending explicit per-entry effective-dependency and typed-governor linkage review; they are not a claim that the normative input remains missing or an automatic scope-wide identity change.
